name: Shoni the Shilent
summary: In Stormwind’s Dwarven District, Shoni the Shilent sends a crew beneath Westfall. She leads the gnomish effort to reclaim Gnomeregan and seeks power for the machines meant to break a path back into the city.

sections.title: Commander of the Deep
sections.body: Shoni the Shilent directs a gnomish assault crew from Stormwind’s Dwarven District. With Gnomeregan held by troggs, she plans to retake the city and sends operatives into the tunnels beneath Westfall for the parts her crew needs.

sections.title: Subterranean Reclamation
sections.body: Shoni’s plan depends on the gnomes’ gyrodrillmatic excavationators, heavy machines built to break through Gnomeregan’s underground borders and open a way for an assault. The machines lack power, so she seeks the intact Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from a working goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines. She also sends adventurers into Gnomeregan to dismantle its robots for spare parts to repair her fleet.

faq.answer: Shoni the Shilent leads the Gnomeregan underground assault crew from Stormwind’s Dwarven District. She coordinates efforts to reclaim the city.
You can find Shoni among the anvils and workshops of Stormwind City’s Dwarven District, near the blacksmithing and engineering areas.

faq.q: Why is Shoni interested in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: A working goblin shredder lies deep in the Deadmines. Shoni seeks its intact Gnoam Sprecklesprocket to power the gyrodrillmatic excavationators and break through Gnomeregan’s underground borders.
No one knows the origin of Shoni’s epithet. She commands the Gnomeregan underground assault crew.

angles.text: As a gnome, helping Shoni brings your people closer to breaking back into Gnomeregan and reclaiming their fallen home.
As an engineer, you can appreciate the mechanical complexity of Shoni’s gyrodrillmatic excavationators, which she hopes to power with a shredder’s salvaged heart from beneath Moonbrook.
